import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import qs.modules.common.widgets as CommonWidgets
import Quickshell.Services.Mpris
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import M3Shapes
import qs.modules.common
import qs.services

ColumnLayout {
    id: root

    property real playerProgress: {
        const active = MprisController.activePlayer;
        return active?.length ? active.position / active.length : 0;
    }

    readonly property bool hasUnknownLength: (MprisController.activePlayer?.length ?? 0) > 2147483647

    function lengthStr(length: int): string {
        if (length < 0)
            return "-1:-1";

        const hours = Math.floor(length / 3600);
        const mins = Math.floor((length % 3600) / 60);
        const secs = Math.floor(length % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");

        if (hours > 0)
            return `${hours}:${mins.toString().padStart(2, "0")}:${secs}`;
        return `${mins}:${secs}`;
    }

    spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small

    Behavior on playerProgress {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    Timer {
        running: MprisController.activePlayer?.isPlaying ?? false
        interval: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.mediaUpdateInterval
        triggeredOnStart: true
        repeat: true
        onTriggered: MprisController.activePlayer?.positionChanged()
    }

    StyledText {
        Layout.fillWidth: true

        animate: true
        text: MprisController.activePlayer?.trackTitle || qsTr("No media")
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large
        elide: Text.ElideRight
    }

    StyledText {
        Layout.fillWidth: true

        animate: true
        text: MprisController.activePlayer?.trackArtist || qsTr("Unknown artist")
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal
        elide: Text.ElideRight
    }

    StyledText {
        Layout.fillWidth: true

        animate: true
        text: MprisController.activePlayer?.trackAlbum || qsTr("Unknown album")
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3tertiary
        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.smaller
        elide: Text.ElideRight
    }

    RowLayout {
        Layout.topMargin: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.large
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small

        // Both time labels reserve the same, worst-case width (all digits
        // zeroed out) so the slider next to them doesn't jitter as the
        // position ticks over from e.g. 0:09 to 0:10.
        TextMetrics {
            id: timeMetrics

            text: MprisController.activePlayer ? root.lengthStr(Math.max(MprisController.activePlayer.position, root.hasUnknownLength ? 0 : MprisController.activePlayer.length)).replace(/[1-9]/g, "0") : "0:00"
            font.family: Appearance.font.family.main
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
        }

        StyledText {
            Layout.preferredWidth: timeMetrics.width
            text: root.lengthStr(MprisController.activePlayer?.position ?? -1)
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
        }

        Item {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            implicitHeight: Math.max(sliderLoader.implicitHeight, progressBarLoader.implicitHeight)

            readonly property bool canSeek: (MprisController.activePlayer?.canSeek ?? false) && !root.hasUnknownLength

            Loader {
                id: sliderLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                active: parent.canSeek
                sourceComponent: CommonWidgets.StyledSlider {
                    configuration: CommonWidgets.StyledSlider.Configuration.Wavy
                    highlightColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
                    trackColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3primaryContainer
                    handleColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
                    value: root.playerProgress

                    onMoved: {
                        const active = MprisController.activePlayer;
                        if (active?.canSeek && active?.positionSupported)
                            active.position = value * active.length;
                    }
                }
            }

            Loader {
                id: progressBarLoader
                anchors {
                    verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                }
                active: !parent.canSeek
                sourceComponent: CommonWidgets.StyledProgressBar {
                    wavy: MprisController.activePlayer?.isPlaying ?? false
                    highlightColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
                    trackColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3primaryContainer
                    value: root.playerProgress
                }
            }
        }

        StyledText {
            Layout.preferredWidth: timeMetrics.width
            text: root.hasUnknownLength ? "--:--" : root.lengthStr(MprisController.activePlayer?.length ?? -1)
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
        }
    }

    RowLayout {
        id: controls

        Layout.topMargin: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.large
        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
        spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small

        Control {
            icon: "shuffle"
            canUse: MprisController.activePlayer?.shuffleSupported ?? false
            toggled: MprisController.activePlayer?.shuffle ?? false
            fontSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.larger

            function onClicked(): void {
                MprisController.activePlayer.shuffle = !MprisController.activePlayer?.shuffle;
            }
        }

        Control {
            icon: "skip_previous"
            canUse: MprisController.activePlayer?.canGoPrevious ?? false

            function onClicked(): void {
                MprisController.activePlayer?.previous();
            }
        }

        Control {
            icon: MprisController.activePlayer?.isPlaying ? "pause" : "play_arrow"
            canUse: MprisController.activePlayer?.canTogglePlaying ?? false
            primary: true
            fontSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.extraLarge

            function onClicked(): void {
                MprisController.activePlayer?.togglePlaying();
            }
        }

        Control {
            icon: "skip_next"
            canUse: MprisController.activePlayer?.canGoNext ?? false

            function onClicked(): void {
                MprisController.activePlayer?.next();
            }
        }

        Control {
            icon: MprisController.activePlayer?.loopState === MprisLoopState.Track ? "repeat_one" : "repeat"
            canUse: MprisController.activePlayer?.loopSupported ?? false
            toggled: MprisController.activePlayer?.loopState === MprisLoopState.Track || MprisController.activePlayer?.loopState === MprisLoopState.Playlist
            fontSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.larger

            function onClicked(): void {
                const state = MprisController.activePlayer.loopState;
                if (state === MprisLoopState.None)
                    MprisController.activePlayer.loopState = MprisLoopState.Track;
                else if (state === MprisLoopState.Track)
                    MprisController.activePlayer.loopState = MprisLoopState.Playlist;
                else
                    MprisController.activePlayer.loopState = MprisLoopState.None;
            }
        }
    }

    // Transport button, drawn on a small morphing Material shape
    // instead of a plain circle - swaps between two "squircle" shapes
    // depending on pressed state for a bit of squash-and-stretch.
    component Control: Item {
        id: control

        required property string icon
        required property bool canUse
        property bool toggled
        property bool primary
        property int fontSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large
        function onClicked(): void {
        }

        readonly property real baseSize: primary ? 1.3 : 1

        implicitWidth: 56 * baseSize
        implicitHeight: implicitWidth

        // Everything visual lives inside `squash` and gets scaled as a
        // whole on press. bg's own implicitSize stays fixed so its path
        // geometry is only ever computed once instead of every animation
        // frame - animating implicitSize directly made MaterialShape
        // regenerate (and subtly re-tessellate) its curve each frame,
        // which is what caused the jitter on the bigger primary button.
        Item {
            id: squash

            anchors.centerIn: parent
            width: parent.width
            height: parent.height
            scale: mouse.pressed ? 0.88 : 1
            transformOrigin: Item.Center

            Behavior on scale {
                animation: Appearance.animation.clickBounce.numberAnimation.createObject(this)
            }

            MaterialShape {
                id: bg

                anchors.fill: parent
                shape: control.primary || control.toggled ? MaterialShape.Cookie4Sided : MaterialShape.Circle
                color: (control.primary || control.toggled) && control.canUse ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primary : Appearance.m3colors.m3primaryContainer
                opacity: control.canUse ? 1 : 0.4

                Behavior on color {
                    ColorAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                    }
                }

                Behavior on shape {
                    NumberAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                    }
                }
            }

            StyledRect {
                anchors.fill: bg
                radius: Appearance.rounding.full
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                opacity: !control.canUse ? 0 : mouse.pressed ? 0.1 : mouse.hovered ? 0.08 : 0

                Behavior on opacity {
                    NumberAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                    }
                }
            }

            MaterialIcon {
                anchors.centerIn: bg

                animate: true
                fill: control.primary || control.toggled ? 1 : 0
                text: control.icon
                color: control.canUse ? (control.primary || control.toggled) ? Appearance.m3colors.m3surface : Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary : Appearance.m3colors.m3tertiary
                font.pointSize: control.fontSize
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            id: mouse

            anchors.fill: parent
            cursorShape: control.canUse ? Qt.PointingHandCursor : undefined
            hoverEnabled: true
            onClicked: control.canUse && control.onClicked()
        }
    }

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets

Item {
    id: root

    readonly property real fadeAmount: 0.1
    property bool flag
    property list<string> lyricList: LyricsService.lyricsLines.map(l => l.text)

    layer.enabled: true
    layer.effect: MultiEffect {
        maskEnabled: true
        maskSpreadAtMin: 1
        maskThresholdMin: 0.5
        maskSource: mask

        Rectangle {
            id: mask

            layer.enabled: true
            visible: false
            implicitWidth: root.width
            implicitHeight: root.height

            gradient: Gradient {
                orientation: Gradient.Vertical

                GradientStop {
                    color: Qt.alpha("black", 0)
                    position: 0
                }
                GradientStop {
                    color: Qt.alpha("black", 1)
                    position: root.fadeAmount
                }
                GradientStop {
                    color: Qt.alpha("black", 1)
                    position: 1 - root.fadeAmount
                }
                GradientStop {
                    color: Qt.alpha("black", 0)
                    position: 1
                }
            }
        }
    }

    state: {
        flag; // Force a re-evaluate; hasLyricsChanged doesn't always propagate to `state` on its own
        if ((LyricsService.status === "ok"))
            return "hasLyrics";
        if ((LyricsService.status === "loading"))
            return "loading";
        return "noLyrics";
    }

    states: [
        State {
            name: "loading"
            PropertyChanges {
                loadingIndicator.opacity: 1
                lyrics.opacity: 0
                noLyrics.opacity: 0
            }
        },
        State {
            name: "hasLyrics"
            PropertyChanges {
                loadingIndicator.opacity: 0
                lyrics.opacity: 1
                noLyrics.opacity: 0
            }
        },
        State {
            name: "noLyrics"
            PropertyChanges {
                loadingIndicator.opacity: 0
                lyrics.opacity: 0
                noLyrics.opacity: 1
            }
        }
    ]

    transitions: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            properties: "opacity"
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    Connections {
        target: LyricsService
        function onStatusChanged() {
            root.flag = !root.flag;
        }
    }

    Loader {
        id: loadingIndicator

        anchors.centerIn: parent
        asynchronous: true
        active: opacity > 0
        opacity: 0

        sourceComponent: ColumnLayout {
            spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.large

            StyledRect {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                implicitWidth: spinner.implicitSize + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
                implicitHeight: implicitWidth
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primaryContainer
                radius: Appearance.rounding.full

                LoadingIndicator {
                    id: spinner

                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    implicitSize: Math.round(Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.mediaSectionWidth / 5)
                    containsIcon: true // Removes the pentagon, which isn't centered
                }
            }

            StyledText {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: qsTr("Loading lyrics...")
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal
            }
        }

        Behavior on opacity {
            NumberAnimation {
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    Loader {
        id: noLyrics

        anchors.centerIn: parent
        asynchronous: true
        active: opacity > 0
        opacity: 0

        sourceComponent: ColumnLayout {
            spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small

            MaterialIcon {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter

                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3tertiary

                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    ListView {
        id: lyrics

        anchors.fill: parent
        anchors.topMargin: parent.height * root.fadeAmount / 2
        anchors.bottomMargin: parent.height * root.fadeAmount / 2

        displayMarginBeginning: anchors.topMargin
        displayMarginEnd: anchors.bottomMargin

        model: root.lyricList
        Component.onCompleted: {
            currentIndex = Qt.binding(() => {
                model; // Force update when lyrics change
                return LyricsService.status === "ok" ? LyricsService.activeIndex : -1;
            });
            positionViewAtIndex(Math.max(0, currentIndex), ListView.Center);
        }
        onModelChanged: Qt.callLater(() => positionViewAtIndex(Math.max(0, currentIndex), ListView.Center))

        highlightRangeMode: ListView.ApplyRange
        highlightMoveDuration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
        highlightMoveVelocity: -1
        preferredHighlightBegin: (height - (currentItem?.implicitHeight ?? 0)) / 2
        preferredHighlightEnd: (height + (currentItem?.implicitHeight ?? 0)) / 2

        spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
        opacity: 0

        delegate: StyledText {
            id: lyric

            required property string modelData
            required property int index
            property real effectScale: ListView.isCurrentItem ? 1 : 0

            anchors.left: lyrics.contentItem.left
            anchors.right: lyrics.contentItem.right

            text: modelData || ". . ."
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            color: ListView.isCurrentItem ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primary : mouse.containsMouse ? Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary : Appearance.m3colors.m3tertiary
            font.pointSize: ListView.isCurrentItem ? Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal : Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.smaller
            wrapMode: Text.WrapAtWordBoundaryOrAnywhere

            layer.enabled: effectScale > 0
            layer.effect: MultiEffect {
                shadowEnabled: true
                shadowColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
                shadowOpacity: 0.5 * lyric.effectScale
                shadowBlur: 0.6 * lyric.effectScale
                blur: 0.4 * lyric.effectScale
            }

            Behavior on effectScale {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }

            MouseArea {
                id: mouse

                anchors.fill: parent
                cursorShape: (LyricsService.status === "ok") ? Qt.PointingHandCursor : undefined
                hoverEnabled: true
                onClicked: {
                    const p = MprisController.activePlayer;
                    if (p && (LyricsService.status === "ok"))
                        p.position = (LyricsService.lyricsLines[lyric.index]?.time ?? 0);
                }
            }
        }

        Behavior on opacity {
            NumberAnimation {
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    Behavior on lyricList {
        SequentialAnimation {
            NumberAnimation {
                target: lyrics
                property: "opacity"
                to: 0
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
            PropertyAction {}
            NumberAnimation {
                target: lyrics
                property: "opacity"
                to: 1
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    id: root

    property real animPerc: UPower.displayDevice?.percentage ?? 0
    readonly property bool charging: [UPowerDeviceState.Charging, UPowerDeviceState.FullyCharged, UPowerDeviceState.PendingCharge].includes(UPower.displayDevice?.state)

    radius: Appearance.rounding.large

    implicitWidth: (Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.performance.showCpu || Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.performance.showGpu || Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.performance.showStorage || Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.performance.showMemory) ?     implicitHeight: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.perfBattHeight

        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    Contents {

        anchors.margins: Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal

    }

    // Liquid fill, bottom-anchored, with a soft wobbling blob edge
    // standing in for a wave.
    Item {
        id: liquid

        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right
        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
        implicitHeight: parent.height * root.animPerc

        clip: true

            smoothing: Appearance.rounding.large

            Behavior on color {
                ColorAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }
        }

        BlobRect {
            id: fillBlob

            anchors.left: parent.left
            anchors.right: parent.right
            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
            anchors.top: parent.top
            anchors.topMargin: -Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

            group: blobGroup
            radius: Appearance.rounding.large
            deformScale: 0.0002

            SequentialAnimation {
                running: root.visible
                loops: Animation.Infinite

                NumberAnimation {
                    target: fillBlob
                    property: "anchors.topMargin"
                    to: -Appearance.dashboard.padding.large - Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
                    duration: 2200
                    easing.type: Easing.InOutSine
                }
                NumberAnimation {
                    target: fillBlob
                    property: "anchors.topMargin"
                    to: -Appearance.dashboard.padding.large
                    duration: 2200
                    easing.type: Easing.InOutSine
                }

        required property color textColour

        MaterialIcon {

            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large
        }

        StyledText {

            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.smaller
        }

        Item {
            Layout.fillHeight: true
        }

        StyledText {
            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
            animate: true
            color: contents.textColour
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
            text: {
                if (UPower.displayDevice?.state === UPowerDeviceState.FullyCharged)
                    return qsTr("Full");
                if (root.charging)
                    return qsTr("Charging");

                const s = UPower.displayDevice?.timeToEmpty;
                if (!s)
                    return qsTr("…");

                const hr = Math.floor(s / 3600);
                const min = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
                return hr > 0 ? `${hr}h ${min}m` : `${min}m`;
            }
        }

        RowLayout {
            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
            spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small

            MaterialIcon {
                text: "bolt"
                color: contents.accentColour
                fill: 1
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large
                opacity: root.charging ? 1 : 0
                scale: root.charging ? 1 : 0

                Behavior on opacity {
                    NumberAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                    }
                }

                Behavior on scale {
                    NumberAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                    }
                }
            }

            StyledText {
                text: `${Math.round((UPower.displayDevice?.percentage ?? 0) * 100)}%`
                color: contents.accentColour
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large
            }
        }
    }

ShapePath {

    required property Wrapper wrapper

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/dashboard/Content.qml
==================================================

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets
import qs.modules.common

Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    readonly property var dashboardTabs: [
        { component: dashComponent, iconName: "dashboard", text: qsTr("Dashboard") },
        { component: mediaComponent, iconName: "queue_music", text: qsTr("Media") },
        { component: performanceComponent, iconName: "speed", text: qsTr("Performance") }
    ]

    readonly property real nonAnimWidth: view.implicitWidth + viewWrapper.anchors.margins * 2

    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
    anchors.top: parent.top

    implicitWidth: nonAnimWidth
    implicitHeight: tabs.implicitHeight + tabs.anchors.bottomMargin + view.implicitHeight + viewWrapper.anchors.margins * 2

    Tabs {
        id: tabs

        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right
        anchors.bottomMargin: Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal
        anchors.margins: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

        nonAnimWidth: root.nonAnimWidth

        // Seed from persisted state on every (re)mount of Content, and
        // write back on every change so the next close/reopen resumes
        // here instead of always falling back to Dash.
        currentIndex: root.visibilities.dashboardTab
        onCurrentIndexChanged: root.visibilities.dashboardTab = currentIndex
    }

    ClippingRectangle {
        id: viewWrapper

        anchors.bottom: tabs.top
        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right
        anchors.top: parent.top
        anchors.margins: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

        radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
        color: "transparent"

        Flickable {
            id: view

            readonly property int currentIndex: tabs.currentIndex
            readonly property Item currentItem: {
                repeater.count;
                return repeater.itemAt(currentIndex);
            }

            anchors.fill: parent
            flickableDirection: Flickable.HorizontalFlick

            implicitWidth: currentItem?.implicitWidth ?? 0
            implicitHeight: currentItem?.implicitHeight ?? 0

            contentX: currentItem?.x ?? 0
            contentWidth: row.implicitWidth
            contentHeight: row.implicitHeight

            onContentXChanged: {
                if (!moving || !currentItem)
                    return;

                const x = contentX - currentItem.x;
                if (x > currentItem.implicitWidth / 2)
                    tabs.bar.incrementCurrentIndex();
                else if (x < -currentItem.implicitWidth / 2)
                    tabs.bar.decrementCurrentIndex();
            }

            onDragEnded: {
                if (!currentItem)
                    return;

                const x = contentX - currentItem.x;
                if (x > currentItem.implicitWidth / 10)
                    tabs.bar.incrementCurrentIndex();
                else if (x < -currentItem.implicitWidth / 10)
                    tabs.bar.decrementCurrentIndex();
                else
                    contentX = Qt.binding(() => currentItem?.x ?? 0);
            }

            RowLayout {
                id: row

                Repeater {
                    id: repeater

                    model: root.dashboardTabs

                    delegate: Loader {
                        id: paneLoader

                        required property int index
                        required property var modelData

                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
                        sourceComponent: modelData.component

                        // Active if current tab, or currently within the
                        // flickable's visible viewport (swipe-in-progress
                        // neighbour). Everything else doesn't exist.
                        Component.onCompleted: active = Qt.binding(() => {
                            if (index === view.currentIndex)
                                return true;
                            const vx = Math.floor(view.visibleArea.xPosition * view.contentWidth);
                            const vex = Math.floor(vx + view.visibleArea.widthRatio * view.contentWidth);
                            return (vx >= x && vx <= x + implicitWidth) || (vex >= x && vex <= x + implicitWidth);
                        })
                    }
                }
            }

            Component {
                id: dashComponent
                Dash {}
            }

            Component {
                id: mediaComponent
                Media {
                    visibilities: root.visibilities
                }
            }

            Component {
                id: performanceComponent
                Performance {}
            }

            Behavior on contentX {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.expressiveDefaultSpatial
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.expressiveDefaultSpatial
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Behavior on implicitWidth {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.emphasized
        }
    }

    Behavior on implicitHeight {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.emphasized
        }
    }
}



==================================================

==================================================

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import "dash"
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.modules.common

GridLayout {
    id: root

    // Kept only because User.qml still takes it - not toggled by anything
    // anymore. Existence of this whole pane (controlled by Content.qml's
    // Repeater) is the only lifecycle switch now. Remove this line and the
    // one below once you confirm User.qml doesn't require it.
    property bool shouldUpdate: true

    rowSpacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.normal
    columnSpacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.normal

    Rect {
        Layout.column: 2
        Layout.columnSpan: 3
        Layout.preferredWidth: user.implicitWidth
        Layout.preferredHeight: user.implicitHeight

        User {
            id: user
            shouldUpdate: root.shouldUpdate
        }
    }

    Rect {
        Layout.row: 0
        Layout.columnSpan: 2
        Layout.preferredWidth: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.weatherWidth
        Layout.fillHeight: true

        Weather {}
    }

Item {

    Component.onCompleted: Cava.active = true
    Component.onDestruction: Cava.active = false

    implicitWidth: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.mediaTabWidth
    implicitHeight: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.mediaTabHeight

    BackgroundShapes {
        anchors.fill: parent
    }

    RowLayout {
        anchors.fill: parent
        anchors.margins: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large
        spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.large

        CoverVisualiser {
            Layout.fillHeight: true
            implicitWidth: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.mediaSectionWidth
        }

        Item {
            id: stateWrapper

            Layout.fillWidth: true
            Layout.fillHeight: true

            property bool hasMedia: MprisController.activePlayer !== null

            // Ignore transient nulls from MPRIS metadata bursts (common
            // right when a track changes) - only actually switch to
            // "no media" if it stays null for a beat. This is what was
            // tearing down the Loaders below mid-build and crashing.
            onHasMediaChanged: {
                if (hasMedia) {
                    noMediaDebounce.stop();
                    stateWrapper.state = "";
                } else {
                    noMediaDebounce.restart();
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: noMediaDebounce
                interval: 300
                onTriggered: stateWrapper.state = "noMedia"
            }

            states: State {
                name: "noMedia"

                PropertyChanges {
                    noMedia.opacity: 1
                    content.opacity: 0
                }
            }

            transitions: Transition {
                NumberAnimation {
                    properties: "opacity"
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }

            Loader {
                id: noMedia

                anchors.centerIn: parent
                anchors.horizontalCenterOffset: -Appearance.dashboard.padding.large * 2
                active: opacity > 0
                opacity: 0
                // synchronous (default) - no incubation window to race

                sourceComponent: ColumnLayout {
                    spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small

                    MaterialShape {
                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                        Layout.topMargin: (pathBounds().height - implicitSize) / 2
                        Layout.bottomMargin: (pathBounds().height - implicitSize) / 2 + Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
                        implicitSize: icon.implicitHeight + Appearance.dashboard.padding.large * 2
                        shape: MaterialShape.ClamShell
                        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primaryContainer

                        MaterialIcon {
                            id: icon
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "queue_music"
                            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.extraLarge
                        }
                    }

                    StyledText {
                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                        text: qsTr("Nothing playing")
                        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
                        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large
                    }

                    StyledText {
                        text: qsTr("Play something for it to show up here!")
                        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                    }
                }
            }

            Loader {
                id: content

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.modules.common.widgets.blobs
import qs.modules.common

Item {
    id: root

    required property real nonAnimWidth
    property alias currentIndex: bar.currentIndex
    readonly property TabBar bar: bar

    implicitHeight: bar.implicitHeight + indicator.implicitHeight + indicator.anchors.bottomMargin + separator.implicitHeight

    TabBar {
        id: bar

        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right
        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom

        background: null

        Tab {
            iconName: "dashboard"
            text: qsTr("Dashboard")
        }

        Tab {
            iconName: "queue_music"
            text: qsTr("Media")
        }

        Tab {
            iconName: "speed"
            text: qsTr("Performance")
        }
    }

    BlobGroup {
        id: indicatorBlobGroup
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
        smoothing: Appearance.rounding.small

        Behavior on color {
            ColorAnimation {
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    Item {
        id: indicator

        anchors.bottom: bar.top
        anchors.bottomMargin: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.tabIndicatorSpacing

        implicitWidth: bar.currentItem.implicitWidth
        implicitHeight: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.tabIndicatorHeight

        x: {
            const tab = bar.currentItem;
            const width = (root.nonAnimWidth - Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.tabIndicatorSpacing * (bar.count - 1) * 2) / bar.count;
            return width * tab.TabBar.index + (width - tab.implicitWidth) / 2;
        }

        clip: true

        BlobRect {
            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
            anchors.left: parent.left
            anchors.right: parent.right
            implicitHeight: parent.implicitHeight * 2

            group: indicatorBlobGroup
            radius: Appearance.rounding.full
        }

        Behavior on x {
            Anim {}
        }

        Behavior on implicitWidth {
            Anim {}
        }
    }

    StyledRect {
        id: separator

        anchors.bottom: indicator.top
        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right

        implicitHeight: 1
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3tertiary
    }

    component Tab: TabButton {
        id: tab

        required property string iconName
        readonly property bool current: TabBar.tabBar.currentItem === this

        background: null

        contentItem: MouseArea {
            id: mouse

            implicitWidth: Math.max(icon.width, label.width)
            implicitHeight: icon.height + label.height

            cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor

            onPressed: ({
                    x,
                    y
                }) => {
                tab.TabBar.tabBar.setCurrentIndex(tab.TabBar.index);

                const stateY = stateWrapper.y;
                rippleAnim.x = x;
                rippleAnim.y = y - stateY;

                const dist = (ox, oy) => ox * ox + oy * oy;
                const stateEndY = stateY + stateWrapper.height;
                rippleAnim.radius = Math.sqrt(Math.max(dist(0, stateY), dist(0, stateEndY), dist(width, stateY), dist(width, stateEndY)));

                rippleAnim.restart();
            }
            onWheel: event => {
                if (event.angleDelta.y < 0)
                    tab.TabBar.tabBar.incrementCurrentIndex();
                else if (event.angleDelta.y > 0)
                    tab.TabBar.tabBar.decrementCurrentIndex();
            }

            SequentialAnimation {
                id: rippleAnim

                property real x
                property real y
                property real radius

                PropertyAction {
                    target: ripple
                    property: "x"
                    value: rippleAnim.x
                }
                PropertyAction {
                    target: ripple
                    property: "y"
                    value: rippleAnim.y
                }
                PropertyAction {
                    target: ripple
                    property: "opacity"
                    value: 0.1
                }
                ParallelAnimation {
                    Anim {
                        target: ripple
                        properties: "implicitWidth,implicitHeight"
                        from: 0
                        to: rippleAnim.radius * 2
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standardDecel
                    }
                    Anim {
                        target: ripple
                        property: "opacity"
                        to: 0
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.large
                        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standardDecel
                    }
                }
            }

            ClippingRectangle {
                id: stateWrapper

                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                implicitHeight: parent.height + Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.sizes.tabIndicatorSpacing * 2

                color: "transparent"
                radius: Appearance.rounding.small

                StyledRect {
                    id: stateLayer

                    anchors.fill: parent

                    color: tab.current ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primary : Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                    opacity: mouse.pressed ? 0.1 : tab.hovered ? 0.08 : 0

                    Behavior on opacity {
                        Anim {}
                    }
                }

                StyledRect {
                    id: ripple

                    radius: Appearance.rounding.full
                    color: tab.current ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primary : Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                    opacity: 0

                    transform: Translate {
                        x: -ripple.width / 2
                        y: -ripple.height / 2
                    }
                }
            }

            MaterialIcon {
                id: icon

                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                anchors.bottom: label.top

                text: tab.iconName
                color: tab.current ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primary : Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
                fill: tab.current ? 1 : 0
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large

                Behavior on fill {
                    NumberAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                    }
                }
            }

            StyledText {
                id: label

                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom

                text: tab.text
                color: tab.current ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primary : Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary
            }
        }
    }

    component Anim: NumberAnimation {
        duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
        easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/dashboard/Wrapper.qml

import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import qs.modules.common

Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    readonly property bool shouldBeActive: root.visibilities.dashboard

    visible: height > 0
    implicitHeight: 0
    // height never auto-tracks implicitHeight in QtQuick - without this,
    // `visible` and anything reading panel.height (Interactions.qml's
    // hover-trigger sizing) were working off a stale/frozen value.
    height: implicitHeight
    implicitWidth: contentLoader.item?.implicitWidth ?? 0

    states: State {
        name: "visible"
        when: root.shouldBeActive

        PropertyChanges {
            root.implicitHeight: contentLoader.item?.implicitHeight ?? 0
        }
    }

    transitions: [
        Transition {
            from: ""
            to: "visible"

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitHeight"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.expressiveDefaultSpatial
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.expressiveDefaultSpatial
            }
        },
        Transition {
            from: "visible"
            to: ""

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitHeight"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.emphasized
            }
        }
    ]

    Loader {
        id: contentLoader

        // The only existence switch for the whole dashboard. Synchronous -
        // no incubation phase to race, no pop-in. Active while it should
        // be open, OR while still visible (mid close-animation, which now
        // actually resolves correctly since height tracks implicitHeight).
        active: root.shouldBeActive || root.visible

        sourceComponent: Content {
            visibilities: root.visibilities
        }
    }
}

                    Wallpapers.randomFromCurrentFolder();
                }

                // Steps to the next/previous wallpaper file in the current
                // folder and applies it directly - handy for binding to
                // media/volume-style keys without opening the drawer.
                function stepWallpaper(direction: int): void {
                    if (Wallpapers.folderModel.count === 0)
                        return;

                    const files = [];
                    for (let i = 0; i < Wallpapers.folderModel.count; i++) {
                        if (Wallpapers.folderModel.get(i, "fileIsDir"))
                            continue;
                        const path = Wallpapers.folderModel.get(i, "filePath");
                        if (path)
                            files.push(path);
                    }
                    if (files.length === 0)
                        return;

                    const currentIdx = files.indexOf(Config.options.background.wallpaperPath);
                    const nextIdx = currentIdx === -1 ? 0 : (currentIdx + direction + files.length) % files.length;
                    Wallpapers.select(files[nextIdx]);
                }

                function next(): void {
                    stepWallpaper(1);
                }

                function prev(): void {
                    stepWallpaper(-1);
                }

                target: "wallpaperDrawer"
            }

            // Opens the session (power) menu in its own right-docked panel
            IpcHandler {
                function toggle(): void {
                    visibilities.session = !visibilities.session;
                    visibilities.launcher = false;
                    visibilities.clipboard = false;
                    visibilities.wallpaper = false;
                }

                function show(): void {
                    visibilities.session = true;
                    visibilities.launcher = false;
                    visibilities.clipboard = false;
                    visibilities.wallpaper = false;
                }

                function close(): void {
                    visibilities.session = false;
                }

                target: "sessionmenu"
            }

            Interactions {
                screen: scope.modelData
                visibilities: visibilities
                panels: panels

                Panels {
                    id: panels

                    screen: scope.modelData
                    visibilities: visibilities
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
//import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.modules.osd as Osd
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common

MouseArea {
    id: root

    required property ShellScreen screen
    required property PersistentProperties visibilities
    required property Panels panels

    property bool osdHovered
    property point dragStart

    // Widened well beyond the visual panel's own width - it was only
    // `rounding` (a few px) either side before, giving a narrow strip
    // centered under the panel instead of a wide hover zone.
    function withinPanelWidth(panel: Item, x: real, y: real): bool {
        const margin = Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.hoverWidthMargin ?? 300;
        return x >= panel.x - margin && x <= panel.x + panel.width + margin;
    }

    function inLeftPanel(panel: Item, x: real, y: real): bool {
        const panelY = Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.thickness + panel.y;
        return x < panel.width + Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.thickness
        && y >= panelY - Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.rounding
        && y <= panelY + panel.height + Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.rounding;
    }

    function inBottomPanel(panel: Item, x: real, y: real): bool {
        const revealed = Math.max(Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.minThickness ?? 4, panel.height);
        return y > root.height - Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.thickness - revealed
        && withinPanelWidth(panel, x, y);
    }

    anchors.fill: parent
    hoverEnabled: true

    onPressed: event => dragStart = Qt.point(event.x, event.y)
    onContainsMouseChanged: {
        if (!containsMouse) {
            //visibilities.osd = false;
            osdHovered = false;
            visibilities.dashboard = false;
        }
    }

    onPositionChanged: ({x, y}) => {
        //const showOsd = inLeftPanel(panels.osd, x, y);
        //visibilities.osd = showOsd;
        //osdHovered = showOsd;

        visibilities.dashboard = inBottomPanel(panels.dashboard, x, y);
    }

    /*Osd.Interactions {
     *       screen: root.screen
     *       visibilities: root.visibilities
     *       hovered: root.osdHovered
}*/
}

import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.common
import qs.modules.common.functions
// Cliphist is the root-level clipboard-history singleton (services/Cliphist.qml).
import qs.services

Item {
    id: root

    required property string modelData
    required property PersistentProperties visibilities
    // Passed down explicitly by ClipboardList's delegate binding (see
    // AppItem.qml for why this is a plain compile-time-bound property
    // instead of something derived from `parent`/`ListView.view`).
    required property real rowWidth
    // Row heights for the two entry kinds - see ClipboardList.qml.
    required property real itemHeight
    required property real imageItemHeight

    readonly property bool isImage: Cliphist.entryIsImage(modelData)
    readonly property string previewText: modelData.replace(/^\s*\S+\s+/, "")
    // cliphist entries are "<id>\t<preview>" - the id is stable for the
    // lifetime of the db and doubles as a cheap on-disk cache key so we
    // only ever decode a given image once.
    readonly property string entryId: modelData.split("\t")[0]
    readonly property string dimensionsLabel: {
        const m = modelData.match(/(\d+x\d+)/);
        return m ? m[1] : qsTr("Image");
    }

    property string imagePath: ""

    implicitHeight: isImage ? imageItemHeight : itemHeight
    width: rowWidth

    // Left click: copy to clipboard and paste it (Cliphist.paste already
    // handles both the classic-cliphist and stash binary cases).
    StateLayer {
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large

        function onClicked(): void {
            Cliphist.paste(root.modelData);
            root.visibilities.launcher = false;
            root.visibilities.clipboard = false;
        }
    }

    // Right click: delete this entry from history. Separate MouseArea
    // stacked above the StateLayer's own (left-button-only) MouseArea -
    // since it only claims the right button, left clicks fall through to
    // StateLayer underneath untouched.
    MouseArea {
        anchors.fill: parent
        acceptedButtons: Qt.RightButton
        onClicked: Cliphist.deleteEntry(root.modelData)
    }

    // Decodes this entry to a cached PNG on disk so it can be shown as a
    // real thumbnail. Only ever runs for image entries, and only once
    // per entryId (subsequent opens just hit the cache file).
    Process {
        id: decodeProc

        readonly property string cacheDir: "~/.cache/quickshell/clipimg"
        readonly property string outPath: `${cacheDir}/${root.entryId}.png`
        readonly property string decodeCmd: Cliphist.cliphistBinary.includes("cliphist") ? `printf '${StringUtils.shellSingleQuoteEscape(root.modelData)}' | ${Cliphist.cliphistBinary} decode` : `${Cliphist.cliphistBinary} decode ${root.entryId}`

        command: ["bash", "-c", `mkdir -p ${cacheDir}; test -s ${outPath} || (${decodeCmd} > ${outPath}); echo ${outPath}`]

        stdout: SplitParser {
            onRead: data => root.imagePath = data
        }
    }

    Component.onCompleted: {
        if (root.isImage)
            decodeProc.running = true;
    }

    Item {
        anchors.fill: parent
        anchors.leftMargin: Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal
        anchors.rightMargin: Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal
        anchors.topMargin: Appearance.dashboard.padding.small
        anchors.bottomMargin: Appearance.dashboard.padding.small

        // Thumbnail - only present for image entries. Deliberately not
        // clipped: fillMode is PreserveAspectFit (not Crop) and there's
        // no ClippingRectangle/radius mask, so the whole image is shown
        // letterboxed instead of having its corners cropped off.
        Item {
            id: thumb

            visible: root.isImage
            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
            implicitWidth: parent.height * 1.6
            implicitHeight: parent.height

            StyledRect {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3surfaceContainerHigh
            }

            Image {
                anchors.fill: parent
                source: root.imagePath ? `file://${root.imagePath}` : ""
                asynchronous: true
                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                sourceSize.width: width
                sourceSize.height: height
            }

            // Only visible while the decode is still in flight.
            MaterialIcon {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                visible: !root.imagePath
                text: "hourglass_empty"
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal
            }
        }

        StyledText {
            anchors.left: root.isImage ? thumb.right : parent.left
            anchors.leftMargin: root.isImage ? Appearance.dashboard.spacing.normal : 0
            anchors.right: parent.right
            anchors.top: root.isImage ? thumb.top : undefined
            anchors.verticalCenter: root.isImage ? undefined : parent.verticalCenter

            text: root.isImage ? root.dimensionsLabel : root.previewText
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurface
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal
            elide: Text.ElideRight
        }
    }
}

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.common

// Delegate for WallpaperCarousel.qml. Styled after caelestia's launcher
// WallpaperItem.qml - scale/fade based on PathView.isCurrentItem/onPath,
// a thumbnail with a filename label underneath. Loads the image directly
// (see the Image block below) rather than through this project's
// CachingImage/Thumbnailer pipeline, which batch-generates thumbnails in
// the background on its own schedule - too unpredictable for something
// that needs to show up the instant you open the carousel.
Item {
    id: root

    // Declared as modelData/index (not e.g. "path") on purpose: with
    // `pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound`, PathView auto-populates required
    // properties on the delegate's root object that match the model's
    // role names. Our model (WallpaperCarousel.entries) is a plain JS
    // array of path strings, so its roles are just "modelData" (the
    // string itself) and "index" (position) - matching these names here
    // lets PathView wire them in directly with no indirection needed in
    // WallpaperCarousel.qml's delegate.
    required property string modelData
    required property int index
    // Back-reference to WallpaperCarousel.qml, passed down by its
    // delegate binding - gives us applyPath()/thumbWidth/thumbHeight
    // without needing a signal that bubbles all the way up through
    // Content.qml.
    required property Item carousel

    readonly property string path: root.modelData
    readonly property string fileName: root.path.split("/").pop()
    readonly property bool isCurrentWallpaper: root.path === Config.options.background.wallpaperPath

    scale: 0.5
    opacity: 0
    z: PathView.z ?? 0 // qmllint disable missing-property

    Component.onCompleted: {
        scale = Qt.binding(() => PathView.isCurrentItem ? 1 : PathView.onPath ? 0.82 : 0);
        opacity = Qt.binding(() => PathView.onPath ? 1 : 0);
    }

    implicitWidth: image.width + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
    implicitHeight: image.height + label.implicitHeight + Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small + Appearance.dashboard.padding.large + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal

    StateLayer {
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large

        // StateLayer declares onClicked as a plain function (see
        // StateLayer.qml), not a signal - so it's overridden by
        // redefining the function here, not with onClicked: ... syntax.
        // Clicking any visible thumbnail (not just the centred one) jumps
        // straight to it and applies it immediately - same as caelestia.
        function onClicked(): void {
            root.carousel.applyPath(root.path);
        }
    }

    StyledClippingRect {
        id: image

        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        y: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3surfaceContainerHigh
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large

        implicitWidth: root.carousel.thumbWidth
        implicitHeight: root.carousel.thumbHeight

        MaterialIcon {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            text: "image"
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3outline
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.extraLarge
        }

        // Loaded directly rather than through CachingImage/Thumbnailer:
        // that pipeline batch-generates thumbnails in the background and
        // this delegate's actual size isn't resolved yet at the moment a
        // CachingImage would ask for one (anchors.fill resolves after
        // this binding runs), which was producing bogus "0x0" thumbnail
        // requests and images that never appeared. sourceSize below asks
        // Qt to decode-and-downscale directly instead, so there's no
        // external cache/generation step to depend on.
        Image {
            anchors.fill: parent
            source: root.path.length > 0 ? `file://${root.path}` : ""
            asynchronous: true
            cache: true
            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
            sourceSize.width: root.carousel.thumbWidth
            sourceSize.height: root.carousel.thumbHeight
        }

        // Thin ring around whatever's currently actually applied, so it's
        // still identifiable even when it's not the centred item.
        StyledRect {
            anchors.fill: parent
            // NOT parent.radius: under `pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound`,
            // `parent`'s static type is the generic Item (no radius
            // property), so that binding silently evaluates to undefined
            // at runtime instead of erroring at compile time. Reference
            // the same token `image` was given directly instead.
            radius: Appearance.rounding.large
            color: "transparent"
            border.width: 2
            border.color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
            opacity: root.isCurrentWallpaper ? 1 : 0

            Behavior on opacity {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }
        }
    }

    StyledText {
        id: label

        anchors.top: image.bottom
        anchors.topMargin: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter

        width: image.width - Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
        elide: Text.ElideRight
        text: root.fileName
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurface
        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
    }

    Behavior on scale {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    Behavior on opacity {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/launcher/AppList.qml

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.modules.launcher.items
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.modules.common
// AppSearch is the root-level app-search singleton (services/AppSearch.qml).
import qs.services

ListView {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities
    required property StyledTextField search
    required property string actionPrefix

    readonly property bool actionMode: search.text.startsWith(actionPrefix)

    // ── Actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Shown when the search box starts with actionPrefix (">"). Each
    // entry needs id/name/description/icon (a Material Symbol name) and
    // an execute() that does whatever the action should do. Add more
    // actions here as you build them out.
    readonly property var actions: [
        {
            id: "clipboard",
            name: qsTr("Clipboard"),
            description: qsTr("View and paste from clipboard history"),
            icon: "content_paste",
            execute: () => {
                root.visibilities.clipboard = true;
                root.visibilities.wallpaper = false;
                root.visibilities.launcher = false;
            }
        },
        {
            id: "wallpaper",
            name: qsTr("Wallpaper"),
            description: qsTr("Browse and apply wallpapers"),
            icon: "wallpaper",
            execute: () => {
                root.visibilities.wallpaper = true;
                root.visibilities.clipboard = false;
                root.visibilities.launcher = false;
            }
        }
    ]
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    // ── Tune size here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Width of the launcher panel (list + search bar match this).
    readonly property int panelWidth: 560
    // How many rows are visible before the list scrolls.
    readonly property int maxShown: 8
    // Rows reserved for the "no results" empty state, so the icon/text
    // don't get cramped when there are 0 matches.
    readonly property int emptyRows: 3
    // Height of a single row (shared by app rows and action rows).
    readonly property int itemHeight: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large * 3.4
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    // Only react to the result count once the user has actually typed
    // something. With an empty search, height stays at the fixed
    // maxShown-rows size, exactly like the old behavior - which is what
    // keeps app-discovery loading right after the shell starts from ever
    // touching the panel's height, since that only happens while search
    // is empty. Once you type (or enter action mode with ">"), AppSearch
    // has long since finished loading, so there's nothing left to jitter.
    readonly property bool searching: search.text.length > 0

    readonly property int visibleRows: !searching ? maxShown : (count > 0 ? Math.min(count, maxShown) : emptyRows)

    readonly property int targetHeight: visibleRows * (itemHeight + spacing) - spacing

    function resultsForText(text: string): var {
        if (actionMode) {
            const query = text.slice(root.actionPrefix.length).trim().toLowerCase();
            if (query === "")
                return root.actions;
            return root.actions.filter(a => a.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || (a.description ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(query));
        }
        return AppSearch.fuzzyQuery(text);
    }

    function refresh(): void {
        resultModel.values = resultsForText(search.text);
        currentIndex = count > 0 ? 0 : -1;
    }

    model: ScriptModel {
        id: resultModel
    }

    Connections {
        function onTextChanged(): void {
            root.refresh();
        }

        target: root.search
    }

    Connections {
        function onLauncherChanged(): void {
            if (root.visibilities.launcher) {
                root.positionViewAtBeginning();
                root.refresh();
            }
        }

        target: root.visibilities
    }

    Component.onCompleted: refresh()

    clip: true
    spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
    implicitWidth: panelWidth
    height: targetHeight
    cacheBuffer: itemHeight * 4
    boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

    Behavior on height {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    preferredHighlightBegin: 0
    preferredHighlightEnd: height
    highlightRangeMode: ListView.ApplyRange
    highlightFollowsCurrentItem: false

    highlight: StyledRect {
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurface
        opacity: 0.08

        y: root.currentItem?.y ?? 0
        implicitWidth: root.width
        implicitHeight: root.currentItem?.implicitHeight ?? 0

        Behavior on y {
            NumberAnimation {
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    // Swaps delegate type based on mode - AppItem expects a DesktopEntry
    // shape (icon/name/comment/execute()), ActionItem expects the plain
    // action-object shape above (icon/name/description/execute()).
    // Reassigning `delegate` when actionMode flips causes the ListView
    // to rebuild its delegates from the new Component, which is cheap
    // given how few rows are ever visible here.
    delegate: root.actionMode ? actionDelegate : appDelegate

    Component {
        id: appDelegate

        AppItem {
            visibilities: root.visibilities
            rowWidth: root.width
        }
    }

    Component {
        id: actionDelegate

        ActionItem {
            visibilities: root.visibilities
            rowWidth: root.width
        }
    }

    add: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            property: "opacity"
            from: 0
            to: 1
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standardDecel
        }
    }

    remove: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            property: "opacity"
            from: 1
            to: 0
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standardAccel
        }
    }

    move: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            property: "y"
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

import QtQuick

// Identical shape logic to ../dashboard/Background.qml - kept as its own
// file (rather than reused directly) because Backgrounds.qml addresses each
// panel's outline by type (Dashboard.Background, Osd.Background, ...) and
// wires startX/startY per-panel. Copy stays in sync manually if you ever
// tweak the corner-rounding math in one of them.
ShapePath {
    id: root

    required property Wrapper wrapper
    readonly property real rounding: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.rounding
    readonly property bool flatten: wrapper.height < rounding * 2
    readonly property real roundingY: flatten ? wrapper.height / 2 : rounding

    strokeWidth: -1
    fillColor: Appearance.m3colors.m3surface

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: -root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
        direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise
    }

    PathLine {
        relativeX: 0
        relativeY: -(root.wrapper.height - root.roundingY * 2)
    }

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: -root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
    }

    PathLine {
        relativeX: root.wrapper.width - root.rounding * 2
        relativeY: 0
    }

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
    }

    PathLine {
        relativeX: 0
        relativeY: root.wrapper.height - root.roundingY * 2
    }

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
        direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise
    }

    Behavior on fillColor {
        ColorAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.modules.launcher.items
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.modules.common
// Cliphist is the root-level clipboard-history singleton (services/Cliphist.qml).
import qs.services

ListView {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities
    required property StyledTextField search

    // ── Tune size here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Width of the launcher panel (list + search bar match this). Keep
    // in sync with AppList.panelWidth so the panel doesn't jump width
    // when switching modes.
    readonly property int panelWidth: 560
    // How many rows are visible before the list scrolls.
    readonly property int maxShown: 8
    // Rows reserved for the "no results" empty state.
    readonly property int emptyRows: 3
    // Height of a single text-clip row.
    readonly property int itemHeight: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.large * 3.4
    // Height of a single image-clip row - taller so thumbnails are
    // actually visible instead of squashed to text-row size.
    readonly property int imageItemHeight: itemHeight * 3
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    readonly property bool searching: search.text.length > 0

    readonly property int visibleRows: !searching ? maxShown : (count > 0 ? Math.min(count, maxShown) : emptyRows)

    // Same fixed formula as AppList - the panel always allocates exactly
    // the same height as the app drawer for the same row count,
    // regardless of whether the visible rows happen to be images. If an
    // image row ends up taller than its allotted slot, the list just
    // scrolls internally (cacheBuffer/clip below) instead of the whole
    // panel growing to fit it.
    readonly property int targetHeight: visibleRows * (itemHeight + spacing) - spacing

    function resultsForText(text: string): var {
        return Cliphist.fuzzyQuery(text);
    }

    function refresh(): void {
        resultModel.values = resultsForText(search.text);
        currentIndex = count > 0 ? 0 : -1;
    }

    model: ScriptModel {
        id: resultModel
    }

    Connections {
        function onTextChanged(): void {
            root.refresh();
        }

        target: root.search
    }

    // Keep the list in sync whenever the underlying clipboard history
    // changes (new copy, delete, wipe, etc.) while the panel is open.
    Connections {
        function onEntriesChanged(): void {
            root.refresh();
        }

        target: Cliphist
    }

    // Force a fresh read from cliphist every time the panel is opened,
    // in case something changed the clipboard while it was closed.
    Connections {
        function onClipboardChanged(): void {
            if (root.visibilities.clipboard) {
                Cliphist.refresh();
                root.positionViewAtBeginning();
                root.refresh();
            }
        }

        target: root.visibilities
    }

    Component.onCompleted: refresh()

    clip: true
    spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
    implicitWidth: panelWidth
    height: targetHeight
    cacheBuffer: itemHeight * 4
    boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

    Behavior on height {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    preferredHighlightBegin: 0
    preferredHighlightEnd: height
    highlightRangeMode: ListView.ApplyRange
    highlightFollowsCurrentItem: false

    highlight: StyledRect {
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurface
        opacity: 0.08

        y: root.currentItem?.y ?? 0
        implicitWidth: root.width
        implicitHeight: root.currentItem?.implicitHeight ?? 0

        Behavior on y {
            NumberAnimation {
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    delegate: ClipItem {
        visibilities: root.visibilities
        rowWidth: root.width
        itemHeight: root.itemHeight
        imageItemHeight: root.imageItemHeight
    }

    add: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            property: "opacity"
            from: 0
            to: 1
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standardDecel
        }
    }

    remove: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            property: "opacity"
            from: 1
            to: 0
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standardAccel
        }
    }

    move: Transition {
        NumberAnimation {
            property: "y"
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    ScrollBar.vertical: StyledScrollBar {}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/launcher/Content.qml
