pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.services

// Layout mirrors caelestia's launcher Content.qml: the search field is
// anchored to the bottom and the result list sits directly above it. The
// panel itself is bottom-docked (see Wrapper.qml), so visually this reads
// as "search bar stays put, results area sits above it" - same as
// caelestia.
//
// Two lists live side by side (AppList / ClipboardList), only one visible
// at a time depending on clipboardMode. currentList is a thin alias that
// points at whichever one is active, so the rest of this file (search
// field, empty state, keyboard nav) doesn't need to care which mode it's
// in.
//
// The wallpaper carousel used to be a third mode here (wallpaperMode) but
// now lives in its own independent panel - see ../wallpaper/Content.qml
// and ../wallpaper/Wrapper.qml - so this file, and Wrapper.qml alongside
// it, no longer know anything about visibilities.wallpaper.
Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    // '>' switches into action mode. AppList.actions holds what's
    // listed there ("Clipboard" and "Wallpaper").
    readonly property string actionPrefix: ">"

    // Live/requested mode - flips the instant visibilities.clipboard
    // changes.
    readonly property bool requestedClipboardMode: root.visibilities.clipboard

    // Displayed/frozen mode - only re-synced while the drawer is
    // actually open (launcher or clipboard visible). When everything
    // closes at once, this deliberately does NOT flip back to appList
    // mid-close, so currentList keeps pointing at whatever it was
    // already showing while the outer Wrapper's height animates down -
    // no mid-shrink list swap, no squish.
    property bool clipboardMode: requestedClipboardMode

    function syncMode(): void {
        if (root.visibilities.launcher || root.visibilities.clipboard) {
            root.clipboardMode = root.requestedClipboardMode;
        }
    }

    readonly property int padding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large // ← outer padding, tune here

    readonly property Item currentList: clipboardMode ? clipList : appList

    implicitWidth: currentList.panelWidth + padding * 2
    implicitHeight: search.implicitHeight + currentList.height + padding * 2 + search.anchors.bottomMargin

    Connections {
        function onLauncherChanged(): void {
            root.syncMode();
        }

        function onClipboardChanged(): void {
            root.syncMode();
        }

        target: root.visibilities
    }

    Item {
        id: listWrapper

        clip: true
        implicitWidth: root.currentList.panelWidth
        implicitHeight: root.currentList.height

        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        anchors.bottom: search.top
        anchors.bottomMargin: root.padding

        AppList {
            id: appList

            visible: !root.clipboardMode
            enabled: visible

            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom

            visibilities: root.visibilities
            search: search
            actionPrefix: root.actionPrefix
        }

        ClipboardList {
            id: clipList

            visible: root.clipboardMode
            enabled: visible

            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom

            visibilities: root.visibilities
            search: search
        }

        // Empty state overlaid on top of the list area (not inside any of
        // the lists themselves, so it isn't at the mercy of Flickable's
        // contentItem reparenting/centering when there are 0 delegates).
        Column {
            visible: opacity > 0
            opacity: root.currentList.count === 0 ? 1 : 0
            scale: root.currentList.count === 0 ? 1 : 0.5

            spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter

            MaterialIcon {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                text: root.clipboardMode ? "content_paste_off" : (appList.actionMode ? "bolt" : "manage_search")
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.extraLarge
            }

            StyledText {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                text: root.clipboardMode ? qsTr("No clipboard history") : (appList.actionMode ? qsTr("No actions yet") : qsTr("No results"))
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal
            }

            StyledText {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                text: root.clipboardMode ? qsTr("Copy something to see it here") : (appList.actionMode ? qsTr("Action modules are coming soon") : qsTr("Try searching for something else"))
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
            }

            Behavior on opacity {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }

            Behavior on scale {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }
        }
    }

    StyledTextField {
        id: search

        objectName: "launcherSearch"

        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right
        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
        anchors.margins: root.padding

        topPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.larger
        bottomPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.larger
        leftPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large
        rightPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.larger // ← search text size, tune here

        placeholderText: root.clipboardMode ? qsTr("Search clipboard history") : qsTr("Search apps, or type \"%1\" for actions").arg(root.actionPrefix)

        background: StyledRect {
            radius: Appearance.rounding.large
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3surfaceContainerHigh
        }

        onAccepted: {
            const currentItem = root.currentList.currentItem;
            if (root.clipboardMode) {
                if (currentItem?.modelData) {
                    Cliphist.paste(currentItem.modelData);
                    root.visibilities.clipboard = false;
                }
            } else if (currentItem?.modelData) {
                currentItem.modelData.execute();
                root.visibilities.launcher = false;
            }
        }

        Keys.onUpPressed: root.currentList.decrementCurrentIndex()
        Keys.onDownPressed: root.currentList.incrementCurrentIndex()

        Keys.onEscapePressed: {
            root.visibilities.launcher = false;
            root.visibilities.clipboard = false;
        }

        Component.onCompleted: forceActiveFocus()

        // Clear + refocus the search box whenever any mode is *entered*
        // (not just when both close), so switching straight from
        // launcher -> clipboard (e.g. via the ">" action) never leaves
        // stale search text (like ">") behind in the other mode.
        Connections {
            function onLauncherChanged(): void {
                if (root.visibilities.launcher) {
                    search.text = "";
                    search.forceActiveFocus();
                } else if (!root.visibilities.clipboard) {
                    search.text = "";
                }
            }

            function onClipboardChanged(): void {
                if (root.visibilities.clipboard) {
                    search.text = "";
                    search.forceActiveFocus();
                } else if (!root.visibilities.launcher) {
                    search.text = "";
                }
            }

            target: root.visibilities
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/launcher/WallpaperCarousel.qml
==================================================

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.modules.launcher.items
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.modules.common.functions
import qs.services

// "Wallpaper" action mode for the launcher (triggered by typing
// ">wallpaper" or picking the "Wallpaper" entry in ">" action mode -
// see AppList.qml).
//
// Styled after caelestia's launcher WallpaperList.qml / WallpaperItem.qml:
// a curved PathView carousel where the centred item is the "selected"
// one. Sliding left/right live-previews the wallpaper under the centred
// item (via Wallpapers.startPreview), exactly like caelestia does with
// Wallpapers.preview(). Unlike caelestia though - which commits the
// wallpaper on every single slide - nothing is actually applied here
// until you press Enter or click a thumbnail directly (see applyPath()).
//
// This talks to this project's own Wallpapers service
// (services/Wallpapers.qml), not caelestia's - the API differs
// (startPreview/stopPreview/select instead of preview/setWallpaper), so
// this is a fresh implementation of caelestia's *look* on top of our own
// existing wallpaper logic (the same logic LocalWallpaperGrid.qml uses).
Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    // ── Tune size here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Sized to actually read as a carousel of wallpapers (like
    // caelestia's), not a row of tiny thumbnails - panelWidth derives
    // from these instead of being pinned to AppList/ClipboardList's 480,
    // so the whole launcher panel widens to fit while this mode is open
    // (Content.qml already sizes itself off currentList.panelWidth).
    readonly property int thumbWidth: 240
    readonly property int thumbHeight: Math.round(thumbWidth / 16 * 9)
    readonly property int itemWidth: thumbWidth + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
    // Thumbnail + top offset + label + breathing room below.
    readonly property int itemHeight: thumbHeight + Appearance.dashboard.padding.large + Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal + 32
    // How many wallpapers are visible across the carousel at once - keep
    // this odd so one is always dead-centre.
    readonly property int numItems: 5
    readonly property int panelWidth: itemWidth * numItems
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    readonly property int count: pathView.count
    readonly property Item currentItem: pathView.currentItem

    // Flat list of image file paths in the wallpapers folder - kept in
    // sync with Wallpapers.folderModel, filtering out subdirectories
    // (this is a quick carousel, not a file browser - use the full
    // wallpaper selector for that).
    property var entries: []

    function refresh(): void {
        const arr = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < Wallpapers.folderModel.count; i++) {
            if (Wallpapers.folderModel.get(i, "fileIsDir"))
                continue;
            const path = Wallpapers.folderModel.get(i, "filePath");
            if (path && path.length > 0)
                arr.push(path);
        }
        root.entries = arr;
    }

    function positionAtCurrentWallpaper(): void {
        const idx = root.entries.indexOf(Config.options.background.wallpaperPath);
        pathView.currentIndex = idx >= 0 ? idx : 0;
    }

    // Applies whatever's currently centred - used when Enter is pressed.
    function applyCurrent(): void {
        root.applyPath(root.entries[pathView.currentIndex]);
    }

    // Applies a specific wallpaper - used when a thumbnail is clicked
    // directly, which may not be the one currently centred.
    function applyPath(path: string): void {
        if (!path || path.length === 0)
            return;
        // Stop preview FIRST so wallpaperPath reverts to the old
        // wallpaper, then select() sets confirmedPath to the new one -
        // same trick WallpaperSelectorContent.qml uses so the real
        // transition animation actually plays instead of being skipped
        // because the path "didn't change" (it was already showing as
        // the live preview).
        if (Config.options.background.enableWallpaperPreview)
            Wallpapers.stopPreview();
        Wallpapers.select(path);
        root.visibilities.wallpaper = false;
    }

    // Mirrors ListView's API so Content.qml can drive this exactly like
    // AppList/ClipboardList without needing to care which mode is active.
    function decrementCurrentIndex(): void {
        pathView.decrementCurrentIndex();
    }

    function incrementCurrentIndex(): void {
        pathView.incrementCurrentIndex();
    }

    // Refresh the entry list whenever the folder's contents actually
    // change...
    Connections {
        function onCountChanged(): void {
            root.refresh();
        }

        target: Wallpapers.folderModel
    }

    // ...and reset back to the default wallpapers folder + jump to
    // whatever's currently applied every time this mode is opened, so it
    // never opens up wherever the full grid selector last left off.
    Connections {
        function onWallpaperChanged(): void {
            if (root.visibilities.wallpaper) {
                Wallpapers.setDirectory(`${Directories.pictures}/Wallpapers`);
                root.refresh();
                root.positionAtCurrentWallpaper();
            } else {
                Wallpapers.stopPreview();
            }
        }

        target: root.visibilities
    }

    Component.onCompleted: root.refresh()
    Component.onDestruction: Wallpapers.stopPreview()

    implicitWidth: root.panelWidth
    implicitHeight: root.itemHeight

    PathView {
        id: pathView

        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        width: root.itemWidth * root.numItems
        height: root.itemHeight

        model: root.entries
        pathItemCount: root.numItems
        cacheItemCount: 5

        snapMode: PathView.SnapToItem
        preferredHighlightBegin: 0.5
        preferredHighlightEnd: 0.5
        highlightRangeMode: PathView.StrictlyEnforceRange

        // This is the "auto preview while sliding" behaviour, copied
        // straight from caelestia's WallpaperList.qml (onCurrentItemChanged
        // -> Wallpapers.preview(...)). Nothing is committed here - just a
        // live preview of whatever's now centred.
        onCurrentIndexChanged: {
            const path = root.entries[currentIndex];
            if (path && Config.options.background.enableWallpaperPreview)
                Wallpapers.startPreview(path);
        }

        delegate: WallpaperItem {
            carousel: root
        }

        path: Path {
            startY: pathView.height / 2

            PathAttribute {
                name: "z"
                value: 0
            }
            PathLine {
                x: pathView.width / 2
                relativeY: 0
            }
            PathAttribute {
                name: "z"
                value: 1
            }
            PathLine {
                x: pathView.width
                relativeY: 0
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/launcher/Wrapper.qml

import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import qs.modules.common

// Same open/close technique as ../dashboard/Wrapper.qml: implicitHeight is
// state-driven and animated with a NumberAnimation, while implicitWidth just
// tracks the content's natural width (never animated). Because this Item
// ends up as a direct child of Panels.qml's root, it's automatically picked
// up by Drawers.qml's per-panel Region mask, so the layershell surface only
// ever punches a hole exactly the size of however tall we currently are.
//
// No longer reacts to visibilities.wallpaper - that mode moved out into
// its own panel, see ../wallpaper/Wrapper.qml.
Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    visible: height > 0
    implicitWidth: content.implicitWidth
    implicitHeight: 0

    states: State {
        name: "visible"
        when: root.visibilities.launcher || root.visibilities.clipboard

        PropertyChanges {
            root.implicitHeight: content.implicitHeight
        }
    }

    transitions: [
        Transition {
            from: ""
            to: "visible"

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitHeight"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.expressiveDefaultSpatial
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.expressiveDefaultSpatial
            }
        },
        Transition {
            from: "visible"
            to: ""

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitHeight"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.emphasized
            }
        }
    ]

    Content {
        id: content

        visibilities: root.visibilities

        anchors.top: parent.top
        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
    }
}

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes
import qs.modules.common

ShapePath {
    id: root

    required property Wrapper wrapper
    readonly property real rounding: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.rounding
    readonly property bool flatten: wrapper.width < rounding * 2
    readonly property real roundingX: flatten ? wrapper.width / 2 : rounding

    strokeWidth: -1
    fillColor: Appearance.colors.colLayer0

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.roundingX
        relativeY: root.rounding
        radiusX: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.width)
        radiusY: root.rounding
        direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise
    }
    PathLine {
        relativeX: (root.wrapper.width - root.roundingX * 2)
        relativeY: 0
    }
    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.roundingX
        relativeY: root.rounding
        radiusX: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.width)
        radiusY: root.rounding
    }
    PathLine {
        relativeX: 0
        relativeY: root.wrapper.height - root.rounding * 2
    }
    PathArc {
        relativeX: -root.roundingX
        relativeY: root.rounding
        radiusX: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.width)
        radiusY: root.rounding
    }
    PathLine {
        relativeX: -(root.wrapper.width - root.roundingX * 2)
        relativeY: 0
    }
    PathArc {
        relativeX: -root.roundingX
        relativeY: root.rounding
        radiusX: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.width)
        radiusY: root.rounding
        direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise
    }

    Behavior on fillColor {
        ColorAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/osd/Content.qml

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.services

Column {
    id: root

    required property Brightness.BrightnessMonitor monitor

    padding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
    anchors.right: parent.right

    spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.normal

    VerticalSlider {
        icon: {
            if (Audio.sink?.audio.muted ?? false)
                return "no_sound";
            if (value > 0.66)
                return "volume_up";
            if (value > 0.33)
                return "volume_down";
            return "volume_mute";
        }
        value: Audio.value
        onMoved: {
            if (Audio.sink) {
                Audio.sink.audio.muted = false;
                Audio.sink.audio.volume = value;
            }
        }

        implicitWidth: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.osd.sizes.sliderWidth
        implicitHeight: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.osd.sizes.sliderHeight
    }

    VerticalSlider {
        icon: `brightness_${(Math.round(value * 6) + 1)}`
        value: root.monitor?.multipliedBrightness ?? 0
        onMoved: root.monitor?.setBrightness(value)

        implicitWidth: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.osd.sizes.sliderWidth
        implicitHeight: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.osd.sizes.sliderHeight
    }
}






==================================================
FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/osd/Interactions.qml
==================================================

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.services

Scope {
    id: root

    required property ShellScreen screen
    required property PersistentProperties visibilities
    required property bool hovered
    readonly property Brightness.BrightnessMonitor monitor: Brightness.getMonitorForScreen(screen)

    function show(): void {
        root.visibilities.osd = true;
        timer.restart();
    }

    Connections {
        target: Audio.sink?.audio ?? null

        function onMutedChanged(): void {
            root.show();
        }

        function onVolumeChanged(): void {
            root.show();
        }
    }

    Connections {
        target: root.monitor

        function onBrightnessChanged(): void {
            root.show();
        }
    }

    Timer {
        id: timer

        interval: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.osd.hideDelay
        onTriggered: {
            if (!root.hovered)
                root.visibilities.osd = false;
        }
    }
}

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.services

Item {
    id: root

    required property ShellScreen screen
    required property bool visibility

    visible: width > 0 // visibilities.osd
    implicitWidth: 0
    implicitHeight: content.implicitHeight

    states: State {
        name: "visible"
        when: root.visibility

        PropertyChanges {
            root.implicitWidth: content.implicitWidth
        }
    }

    transitions: [
        Transition {
            from: ""
            to: "visible"

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitWidth"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.expressiveFastSpatial
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.expressiveFastSpatial
            }
        },
        Transition {
            from: "visible"
            to: ""

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitWidth"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.emphasized
            }
        }
    ]

    Content {
        id: content

        monitor: Brightness.getMonitorForScreen(root.screen)
    }
}

        command: ["systemctl", "poweroff"]

        sourceSize.height: height

    SessionButton {
        id: hibernate

        icon: "downloading"
        command: ["systemctl", "hibernate"]

        KeyNavigation.up: shutdown
        KeyNavigation.down: reboot
    }

    SessionButton {
        id: reboot

        icon: "cached"
        command: ["systemctl", "reboot"]

        KeyNavigation.up: hibernate
    }

    component SessionButton: StyledRect {
        id: button

        required property string icon
        required property list<string> command

        implicitWidth: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.session.sizes.button
        implicitHeight: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.session.sizes.button

        radius: Appearance.rounding.large
        color: button.activeFocus ? Appearance.m3colors.m3primaryContainer : Appearance.m3colors.m3surfaceContainer

            id: proc

            command: button.command

        StateLayer {
            radius: parent.radius

            function onClicked(): void {
                proc.startDetached();

            anchors.centerIn: parent

            text: button.icon
            color: button.activeFocus ? Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary : Appearance.m3colors.m3secondary

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.common
import qs.modules.common.widgets as CommonWidgets

Item {
    id: root

    required property string modelData
    required property int index
    required property Item carousel

    readonly property string path: root.modelData
    readonly property string fileName: root.path.split("/").pop()
    readonly property bool isCurrentWallpaper: root.path === Config.options.background.wallpaperPath

    scale: 0.5
    opacity: 0
    z: PathView.z ?? 0 // qmllint disable missing-property

    Component.onCompleted: {
        // 0.8, matching Caelestia exactly (was 0.82)
        scale = Qt.binding(() => PathView.isCurrentItem ? 1 : PathView.onPath ? 0.8 : 0);
        opacity = Qt.binding(() => PathView.onPath ? 1 : 0);
    }

    implicitWidth: image.width + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
    implicitHeight: image.height + label.implicitHeight + Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small + Appearance.dashboard.padding.large + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal

    StateLayer {
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large

        function onClicked(): void {
            root.carousel.applyPath(root.path);
        }
    }

    StyledClippingRect {
        id: image

        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        y: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3surfaceContainerHigh
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large

        implicitWidth: root.carousel.thumbWidth
        implicitHeight: root.carousel.thumbHeight

        MaterialIcon {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            text: "image"
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3outline
            font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.extraLarge
        }

        Image {
            anchors.fill: parent
            source: root.path.length > 0 ? `file://${root.path}` : ""
            asynchronous: true
            cache: true
            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
            sourceSize.width: root.carousel.thumbWidth
            sourceSize.height: root.carousel.thumbHeight
            // Skip bilinear filtering while the carousel is actively being
            // dragged - matches Caelestia, crisper/cheaper during motion,
            // smooths back in the instant it settles.
            smooth: !root.PathView.view.moving
        }

        StyledRect {
            anchors.fill: parent
            radius: Appearance.rounding.large
            color: "transparent"
            border.width: 2
            border.color: Appearance.m3colors.m3primary
            opacity: root.isCurrentWallpaper ? 1 : 0

            Behavior on opacity {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Qualified via CommonWidgets. so it doesn't drag common/widgets'
    // StyledText/StateLayer/etc. into this file's scope and shadow the
    // dashboard2 versions used everywhere else here - that collision was
    // the actual source of the pixelSize/pointSize warnings.
    CommonWidgets.StyledRectangularShadow {
        target: image
        z: -1
        opacity: root.PathView.isCurrentItem ? 1 : 0

        Behavior on opacity {
            NumberAnimation {
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
            }
        }
    }

    StyledText {
        id: label

        anchors.top: image.bottom
        anchors.topMargin: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter

        width: image.width - Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
        elide: Text.ElideRight
        text: root.fileName
        color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurface
        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
    }

    Behavior on scale {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }

    Behavior on opacity {
        NumberAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }
}

import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.services
import qs.modules.common

// Identical shape logic to ../launcher/Background.qml and
// ../dashboard/Background.qml - kept as its own file for the same reason
// as the launcher's copy: Backgrounds.qml addresses each panel's outline
// by type (Dashboard.Background, Launcher.Background, Wallpaper.Background,
// ...) and wires startX/startY per-panel. Copy stays in sync manually if
// you ever tweak the corner-rounding math in one of them.
ShapePath {
    id: root

    required property Wrapper wrapper
    readonly property real rounding: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.border.rounding
    readonly property bool flatten: wrapper.height < rounding * 2
    readonly property real roundingY: flatten ? wrapper.height / 2 : rounding

    strokeWidth: -1
    fillColor: Appearance.colors.colLayer0

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: -root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
        direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise
    }

    PathLine {
        relativeX: 0
        relativeY: -(root.wrapper.height - root.roundingY * 2)
    }

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: -root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
    }

    PathLine {
        relativeX: root.wrapper.width - root.rounding * 2
        relativeY: 0
    }

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
    }

    PathLine {
        relativeX: 0
        relativeY: root.wrapper.height - root.roundingY * 2
    }

    PathArc {
        relativeX: root.rounding
        relativeY: root.roundingY
        radiusX: root.rounding
        radiusY: Math.min(root.rounding, root.wrapper.height)
        direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise
    }

    Behavior on fillColor {
        ColorAnimation {
            duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
            easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
            easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/wallpaper/Content.qml

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.services

// Split out of ../launcher/Content.qml's old wallpaperMode branch so the
// carousel's sizing/animation/keyboard-handling is fully self-contained
// and doesn't have to be threaded through the launcher's
// clipboardMode/wallpaperMode plumbing anymore.
//
// The search field is a real filename filter (bound to
// WallpaperCarousel.filterText) as well as a key-handling surface: type
// to narrow the carousel down by filename, Enter to apply, Esc to close.
// ← → browse the carousel only while the box is empty; once you've typed
// something, ← → fall through to normal text-cursor movement instead.
Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    readonly property int padding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

    implicitWidth: carousel.panelWidth + padding * 2
    implicitHeight: search.implicitHeight + carousel.height + padding * 2 + search.anchors.bottomMargin

    Item {
        id: listWrapper

        clip: true
        implicitWidth: carousel.panelWidth
        implicitHeight: carousel.height

        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        anchors.bottom: search.top
        anchors.bottomMargin: root.padding

        WallpaperCarousel {
            id: carousel

            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom

            visibilities: root.visibilities
            filterText: search.text
        }

        // Empty state overlaid on top of the carousel area, same as the
        // launcher's - not inside the carousel itself so it isn't at the
        // mercy of PathView's delegate lifecycle when there are 0 items.
        Column {
            visible: opacity > 0
            opacity: carousel.count === 0 ? 1 : 0
            scale: carousel.count === 0 ? 1 : 0.5

            spacing: Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter

            MaterialIcon {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                text: "wallpaper"
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.extraLarge
            }

            StyledText {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                text: search.text.length > 0 ? qsTr("No wallpapers match \"%1\"").arg(search.text) : qsTr("No wallpapers found")
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.normal
            }

            StyledText {
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                text: search.text.length > 0 ? qsTr("Try a different name") : qsTr("Add images to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers")
                color: Appearance.m3colors.m3onSurfaceVariant
                font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.small
            }

            Behavior on opacity {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }

            Behavior on scale {
                NumberAnimation {
                    duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.small
                    easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                    easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.standard
                }
            }
        }
    }

    StyledTextField {
        id: search

        objectName: "wallpaperSearch"

        anchors.left: parent.left
        anchors.right: parent.right
        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
        anchors.margins: root.padding

        topPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.larger
        bottomPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.larger
        leftPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large
        rightPadding: Appearance.dashboard.padding.large

        font.pointSize: Appearance.dashboard.fontSize.larger

        placeholderText: qsTr("Search by name, ← → to browse, Enter to set")

        background: StyledRect {
            radius: Appearance.rounding.large
            color: Appearance.m3colors.m3surfaceContainerHigh
        }

        onAccepted: carousel.applyCurrent()

        // Only steal ← → for carousel browsing while the box is empty -
        // once there's text in it, arrows fall through (event.accepted =
        // false) so they move the cursor between letters like a normal
        // text field instead.
        Keys.onLeftPressed: event => {
            if (search.text.length === 0) {
                carousel.decrementCurrentIndex();
                event.accepted = true;
            } else {
                event.accepted = false;
            }
        }
        Keys.onRightPressed: event => {
            if (search.text.length === 0) {
                carousel.incrementCurrentIndex();
                event.accepted = true;
            } else {
                event.accepted = false;
            }
        }

        Keys.onEscapePressed: root.visibilities.wallpaper = false

        Component.onCompleted: forceActiveFocus()

        // Clear any leftover filter text + refocus every time this panel
        // is opened, so it never opens up still filtered from last time.
        Connections {
            function onWallpaperChanged(): void {
                if (root.visibilities.wallpaper) {
                    search.text = "";
                    search.forceActiveFocus();
                }
            }

            target: root.visibilities
        }
    }
}



==================================================
FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/modules/wallpaper/WallpaperCarousel.qml
==================================================

pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.widgets
import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.modules.wallpaper.items
import Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common
import qs.modules.common.functions
import qs.services

Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    // ── Tune size here ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    readonly property int thumbWidth: 320
    readonly property int thumbHeight: Math.round(thumbWidth / 16 * 9)
    // Caelestia's exact formula: item spacing along the path is only 0.8x
    // the actual thumbnail width, not the full width + padding - that's
    // what makes neighbouring cards overlap into a fanned deck instead of
    // sitting in a plain, evenly-gapped row.
    readonly property int itemSpacing: Math.round(thumbWidth * 0.8) + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal * 2
    readonly property int itemHeight: thumbHeight + Appearance.dashboard.padding.large + Appearance.dashboard.spacing.small + Appearance.dashboard.padding.normal + 32
    readonly property int numItems: 5
    readonly property int panelWidth: itemSpacing * numItems
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    readonly property int count: pathView.count
    readonly property Item currentItem: pathView.currentItem

    property string filterText: ""
    property var allEntries: []

    readonly property var entries: {
        const needle = root.filterText.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (needle.length === 0)
            return root.allEntries;
        return root.allEntries.filter(path => path.split("/").pop().toLowerCase().includes(needle));
    }

    function refresh(): void {
        const arr = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < Wallpapers.folderModel.count; i++) {
            if (Wallpapers.folderModel.get(i, "fileIsDir"))
                continue;
            const path = Wallpapers.folderModel.get(i, "filePath");
            if (path && path.length > 0)
                arr.push(path);
        }
        root.allEntries = arr;
    }

    onFilterTextChanged: pathView.currentIndex = 0

    function positionAtCurrentWallpaper(): void {
        const idx = root.entries.indexOf(Config.options.background.wallpaperPath);
        pathView.currentIndex = idx >= 0 ? idx : 0;
    }

    function applyCurrent(): void {
        root.applyPath(root.entries[pathView.currentIndex]);
    }

    function applyPath(path: string): void {
        if (!path || path.length === 0)
            return;
        if (Config.options.background.enableWallpaperPreview)
            Wallpapers.stopPreview();
        Wallpapers.select(path);
        root.visibilities.wallpaper = false;
    }

    function decrementCurrentIndex(): void {
        pathView.decrementCurrentIndex();
    }

    function incrementCurrentIndex(): void {
        pathView.incrementCurrentIndex();
    }

    Connections {
        function onCountChanged(): void {
            root.refresh();
        }

        target: Wallpapers.folderModel
    }

    Connections {
        function onWallpaperChanged(): void {
            if (root.visibilities.wallpaper) {
                Wallpapers.setDirectory(`${Directories.pictures}/Wallpapers`);
                root.refresh();
                root.positionAtCurrentWallpaper();
            } else {
                Wallpapers.stopPreview();
            }
        }

        target: root.visibilities
    }

    Component.onCompleted: root.refresh()
    Component.onDestruction: Wallpapers.stopPreview()

    implicitWidth: root.panelWidth
    implicitHeight: root.itemHeight

    PathView {
        id: pathView

        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
        width: root.itemSpacing * root.numItems
        height: root.itemHeight

        model: root.entries
        pathItemCount: root.numItems
        cacheItemCount: 5

        snapMode: PathView.SnapToItem
        preferredHighlightBegin: 0.5
        preferredHighlightEnd: 0.5
        highlightRangeMode: PathView.StrictlyEnforceRange

        onCurrentIndexChanged: {
            const path = root.entries[currentIndex];
            if (path && Config.options.background.enableWallpaperPreview)
                Wallpapers.startPreview(path);
        }

        delegate: WallpaperItem {
            carousel: root
        }

        path: Path {
            startY: pathView.height / 2

            PathAttribute {
                name: "z"
                value: 0
            }
            PathLine {
                x: pathView.width / 2
                relativeY: 0
            }
            PathAttribute {
                name: "z"
                value: 1
            }
            PathLine {
                x: pathView.width
                relativeY: 0
            }
        }
    }
}

import QtQuick
import Quickshell
import qs.modules.common

// Independent from ../launcher/Wrapper.qml on purpose. The wallpaper
// carousel used to live inside the launcher's Content.qml/Wrapper.qml as
// a third mode (alongside AppList/ClipboardList), sharing its
// implicitWidth/implicitHeight and open/close state - which meant any
// launcher-side sizing quirk could bleed into the wallpaper panel (and
// vice versa). This wrapper only knows about visibilities.wallpaper and
// only sizes itself off its own Content below; the launcher wrapper no
// longer has any concept of wallpaper mode at all.
//
// Same open/close technique as ../launcher/Wrapper.qml and
// ../dashboard/Wrapper.qml: implicitHeight is state-driven and animated
// with a NumberAnimation, while implicitWidth just tracks the content's
// natural width (never animated). Because this Item ends up as a direct
// child of Panels.qml's root, it's automatically picked up by
// Drawers.qml's per-panel Region mask, so the layershell surface only
// ever punches a hole exactly the size of however tall we currently are.
Item {
    id: root

    required property PersistentProperties visibilities

    visible: height > 0
    implicitWidth: content.implicitWidth
    implicitHeight: 0

    states: State {
        name: "visible"
        when: root.visibilities.wallpaper

        PropertyChanges {
            root.implicitHeight: content.implicitHeight
        }
    }

    transitions: [
        Transition {
            from: ""
            to: "visible"

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitHeight"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.expressiveDefaultSpatial
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.expressiveDefaultSpatial
            }
        },
        Transition {
            from: "visible"
            to: ""

            NumberAnimation {
                target: root
                property: "implicitHeight"
                duration: Appearance.dashboard.durations.normal
                easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline
                easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animationCurves.emphasized
            }
        }
    ]

    Content {
        id: content

        visibilities: root.visibilities

        anchors.top: parent.top
        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/services/NetworkUsage.qml
==================================================

pragma Singleton

import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick
import qs.modules.common

// Lightweight replacement for Caelestia's compiled NetworkUsage service.
// Polls /proc/net/dev (skipping loopback) and derives instantaneous
// upload/download speed plus running session totals and small ring
// buffers for a sparkline.
Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property int historyLength: 60
    property bool active: false

    property real downloadSpeed: 0 // bytes/sec
    property real uploadSpeed: 0 // bytes/sec
    property real downloadTotal: 0 // bytes, since shell start
    property real uploadTotal: 0 // bytes, since shell start

    property list<real> downloadHistory: []
    property list<real> uploadHistory: []
    // Kept for API-compatibility with a Sparkline that wants {values,maximum,count}
    readonly property var downloadBuffer: ({
            values: downloadHistory,
            maximum: Math.max(1024, ...downloadHistory, 0),
            count: downloadHistory.length
        })
    readonly property var uploadBuffer: ({
            values: uploadHistory,
            maximum: Math.max(1024, ...uploadHistory, 0),
            count: uploadHistory.length
        })

    property var _lastRx: ({})
    property var _lastTx: ({})
    property bool _firstSample: true

    function formatBytes(bytesPerSec: real): var {
        if (!isFinite(bytesPerSec) || bytesPerSec < 0)
            bytesPerSec = 0;

        const units = ["B/s", "KB/s", "MB/s", "GB/s"];
        let value = bytesPerSec;
        let i = 0;
        while (value >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
            value /= 1024;
            i++;
        }
        return {
            value,
            unit: units[i]
        };
    }

    function formatBytesTotal(bytes: real): var {
        if (!isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0)
            bytes = 0;

        const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
        let value = bytes;
        let i = 0;
        while (value >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
            value /= 1024;
            i++;
        }
        return {
            value,
            unit: units[i]
        };
    }

    Timer {
        interval: Config.options.caelestiaDashboard.dashboard.resourceUpdateInterval
        running: root.active        // was: true
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: proc.running = true
    }

    Process {
        id: proc

        command: ["cat", "/proc/net/dev"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: {
                const lines = text.split("\n").slice(2); // skip the two header lines
                let rx = 0;
                let tx = 0;

                for (const line of lines) {
                    const trimmed = line.trim();
                    if (!trimmed)
                        continue;

                    const [iface, rest] = trimmed.split(":");
                    if (!rest || iface.startsWith("lo"))
                        continue;

                    const fields = rest.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
                    rx += fields[0] ?? 0; // bytes received
                    tx += fields[8] ?? 0; // bytes transmitted
                }

                const now = Date.now();
                const dtSec = root._lastTime ? Math.max(0.001, (now - root._lastTime) / 1000) : 1;

                if (!root._firstSample) {
                    const drx = Math.max(0, rx - root._lastRxTotal);
                    const dtx = Math.max(0, tx - root._lastTxTotal);

                    root.downloadSpeed = drx / dtSec;
                    root.uploadSpeed = dtx / dtSec;
                    root.downloadTotal += drx;
                    root.uploadTotal += dtx;

                    root.downloadHistory = [...root.downloadHistory, root.downloadSpeed].slice(-root.historyLength);
                    root.uploadHistory = [...root.uploadHistory, root.uploadSpeed].slice(-root.historyLength);
                }

                root._lastRxTotal = rx;
                root._lastTxTotal = tx;
                root._lastTime = now;
                root._firstSample = false;
            }
        }
    }

    property real _lastRxTotal: 0
    property real _lastTxTotal: 0
    property real _lastTime: 0
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/services/SystemUsage.qml
==================================================

pragma Singleton

import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root

    property real cpuPerc
    property real cpuTemp
    property real gpuPerc
    property real gpuTemp
    property int memUsed
    property int memTotal
    property bool active: false
    readonly property real memPerc: memTotal > 0 ? memUsed / memTotal : 0
    property int storageUsed
    property int storageTotal
    property real storagePerc: storageTotal > 0 ? storageUsed / storageTotal : 0

    // --- New: read once at startup, used as HeroCard sub-labels ---
    property string cpuName: qsTr("Loading…")
    property string gpuName: qsTr("Loading…")

    property int lastCpuIdle
    property int lastCpuTotal

    function formatKib(kib: int): var {
        const mib = 1024;
        const gib = 1024 ** 2;
        const tib = 1024 ** 3;

        if (kib >= tib)
            return {
                value: kib / tib,
                unit: "TiB"
            };
        if (kib >= gib)
            return {
                value: kib / gib,
                unit: "GiB"
            };
        if (kib >= mib)
            return {
                value: kib / mib,
                unit: "MiB"
            };
        return {
            value: kib,
            unit: "KiB"
        };
    }

    Timer {
        running: root.active      // <-- was: true
        interval: 3000
        repeat: true
        triggeredOnStart: true    // <-- add this so it refreshes immediately when opened, not after a 3s wait
        onTriggered: {
            stat.reload();
            meminfo.reload();
            storage.running = true;
            cpuTemp.running = true;
            gpuUsage.running = true;
            gpuTemp.running = true;
        }
    }

    FileView {
        id: stat

        path: "/proc/stat"
        onLoaded: {
            const data = text().match(/^cpu\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)/);
            if (data) {
                const stats = data.slice(1).map(n => parseInt(n, 10));
                const total = stats.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
                const idle = stats[3];

                const totalDiff = total - root.lastCpuTotal;
                const idleDiff = idle - root.lastCpuIdle;
                root.cpuPerc = totalDiff > 0 ? (1 - idleDiff / totalDiff) : 0;

                root.lastCpuTotal = total;
                root.lastCpuIdle = idle;
            }
        }
    }

    FileView {
        id: meminfo

        path: "/proc/meminfo"
        onLoaded: {
            const data = text();
            root.memTotal = parseInt(data.match(/MemTotal: *(\d+)/)[1], 10) || 1;
            root.memUsed = (root.memTotal - parseInt(data.match(/MemAvailable: *(\d+)/)[1], 10)) || 0;
        }
    }

    Process {
        id: storage

        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "df | grep '^/dev/' | awk '{print $1, $3, $4}'"]
        stdout: SplitParser {
            splitMarker: ""
            onRead: data => {
                const deviceMap = new Map();

                for (const line of data.trim().split("\n")) {
                    if (line.trim() === "") continue;

                    const parts = line.trim().split(/\s+/);
                    if (parts.length >= 3) {
                        const device = parts[0];
                        const used = parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0;
                        const avail = parseInt(parts[2], 10) || 0;

                        // only keep the entry with the largest total space for each device
                        if (!deviceMap.has(device) ||
                            (used + avail) > (deviceMap.get(device).used + deviceMap.get(device).avail)) {
                            deviceMap.set(device, { used: used, avail: avail });
                            }
                    }
                }

                let totalUsed = 0;
                let totalAvail = 0;

                for (const [device, stats] of deviceMap) {
                    totalUsed += stats.used;
                    totalAvail += stats.avail;
                }

                root.storageUsed = totalUsed;
                root.storageTotal = totalUsed + totalAvail;
            }
        }
    }

    Process {
        id: cpuTemp

        running: true
        command: ["fish", "-c", "cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp | string join ' '"]
        stdout: SplitParser {
            onRead: data => {
                const temps = data.trim().split(" ");
                const sum = temps.reduce((acc, d) => acc + parseInt(d, 10), 0);
                root.cpuTemp = sum / temps.length / 1000;
            }
        }
    }

    Process {
        id: gpuUsage

        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits"]
        stdout: SplitParser {
            splitMarker: ""
            onRead: data => {
                const percs = data.trim().split("\n").filter(l => l.trim() !== "");
                if (percs.length === 0)
                    return;
                const sum = percs.reduce((acc, d) => acc + parseInt(d, 10), 0);
                root.gpuPerc = sum / percs.length / 100;
            }
        }
    }

    Process {
        id: gpuTemp

        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits"]
        stdout: SplitParser {
            splitMarker: ""
            onRead: data => {
                const temps = data.trim().split("\n").filter(l => l.trim() !== "").map(t => parseFloat(t));
                root.gpuTemp = temps.length > 0 ? temps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / temps.length : 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // --- New: one-shot name lookups for the HeroCard sub-labels ---
    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d: -f2"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.cpuName = text.trim() || qsTr("Unknown CPU")
        }
    }

    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.gpuName = text.trim().split("\n")[0] || qsTr("Unknown GPU")
        }
    }
}

pragma Singleton
pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound

import qs.modules.ii.dashboard2.utils
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property string thumbDir: `${Paths.cache}/thumbnails`.slice(7)

    function go(obj: var): var {
        return thumbComp.createObject(obj, {
            originalPath: obj.path,
            width: obj.width,
            height: obj.height,
            loadOriginal: obj.loadOriginal
        });
    }

    component Thumbnail: QtObject {
        id: obj

        required property string originalPath
        required property int width
        required property int height
        required property bool loadOriginal

        property string path

        readonly property Process proc: Process {
            running: true
            command: ["fish", "-c", `
set -l path "${root.thumbDir}/$(sha1sum ${obj.originalPath} | cut -d ' ' -f 1)@${obj.width}x${obj.height}-exact.png"
if test -f $path
    echo $path
else
    echo 'start'
    set -l size (identify -ping -format '%w\n%h' ${obj.originalPath})
    if test $size[1] -gt ${obj.width} -o $size[2] -gt ${obj.height}
        magick ${obj.originalPath} -${obj.width > 1024 || obj.height > 1024 ? "resize" : "thumbnail"} ${obj.width}x${obj.height}^ -background none -gravity center -extent ${obj.width}x${obj.height} -unsharp 0x.5 $path
    else
        cp ${obj.originalPath} $path
    end
    echo $path
end`]
            stdout: SplitParser {
                onRead: data => {
                    if (data === "start") {
                        if (obj.loadOriginal)
                            obj.path = obj.originalPath;
                    } else {
                        obj.path = data;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function reload(): void {
            proc.signal(9);
            proc.running = true;
        }
    }

    Component {
        id: thumbComp

        Thumbnail {}
    }
}

FILE: ./modules/ii/dashboard2/utils/scripts/fuzzysort.js

.pragma library

var single =  (search, target) => {
    if(!search || !target) return NULL

    var preparedSearch = getPreparedSearch(search)
    if(!isPrepared(target)) target = getPrepared(target)

    var searchBitflags = preparedSearch.bitflags
    if((searchBitflags & target._bitflags) !== searchBitflags) return NULL

    return algorithm(preparedSearch, target)
}

var go = (search, targets, options) => {
    if(!search) return options?.all ? all(targets, options) : noResults

    var preparedSearch = getPreparedSearch(search)
    var searchBitflags = preparedSearch.bitflags
    var containsSpace  = preparedSearch.containsSpace

    var threshold = denormalizeScore( options?.threshold || 0 )
    var limit     = options?.limit || INFINITY

    var resultsLen = 0; var limitedCount = 0
    var targetsLen = targets.length

    function push_result(result) {
    if(resultsLen < limit) { q.add(result); ++resultsLen }
    else {
        ++limitedCount
        if(result._score > q.peek()._score) q.replaceTop(result)
    }
    }

    // This code is copy/pasted 3 times for performance reasons [options.key, options.keys, no keys]

    // options.key
    if(options?.key) {
    var key = options.key
    for(var i = 0; i < targetsLen; ++i) { var obj = targets[i]
        var target = getValue(obj, key)
        if(!target) continue
        if(!isPrepared(target)) target = getPrepared(target)

        if((searchBitflags & target._bitflags) !== searchBitflags) continue
        var result = algorithm(preparedSearch, target)
        if(result === NULL) continue
        if(result._score < threshold) continue

        result.obj = obj
        push_result(result)
    }

    // options.keys
    } else if(options?.keys) {
    var keys = options.keys
    var keysLen = keys.length

    outer: for(var i = 0; i < targetsLen; ++i) { var obj = targets[i]

        { // early out based on bitflags
        var keysBitflags = 0
        for (var keyI = 0; keyI < keysLen; ++keyI) {
            var key = keys[keyI]
            var target = getValue(obj, key)
            if(!target) { tmpTargets[keyI] = noTarget; continue }
            if(!isPrepared(target)) target = getPrepared(target)
            tmpTargets[keyI] = target

            keysBitflags |= target._bitflags
        }

        if((searchBitflags & keysBitflags) !== searchBitflags) continue
        }

        if(containsSpace) for(let i=0; i<preparedSearch.spaceSearches.length; i++) keysSpacesBestScores[i] = NEGATIVE_INFINITY

        for (var keyI = 0; keyI < keysLen; ++keyI) {
        target = tmpTargets[keyI]
        if(target === noTarget) { tmpResults[keyI] = noTarget; continue }

        tmpResults[keyI] = algorithm(preparedSearch, target, /*allowSpaces=*/false, /*allowPartialMatch=*/containsSpace)
        if(tmpResults[keyI] === NULL) { tmpResults[keyI] = noTarget; continue }

        // todo: this seems weird and wrong. like what if our first match wasn't good. this should just replace it instead of averaging with it
        // if our second match isn't good we ignore it instead of averaging with it
        if(containsSpace) for(let i=0; i<preparedSearch.spaceSearches.length; i++) {
            if(allowPartialMatchScores[i] > -1000) {
            if(keysSpacesBestScores[i] > NEGATIVE_INFINITY) {
                var tmp = (keysSpacesBestScores[i] + allowPartialMatchScores[i]) / 4/*bonus score for having multiple matches*/
                if(tmp > keysSpacesBestScores[i]) keysSpacesBestScores[i] = tmp
            }
            }
            if(allowPartialMatchScores[i] > keysSpacesBestScores[i]) keysSpacesBestScores[i] = allowPartialMatchScores[i]
        }
        }

        if(containsSpace) {
        for(let i=0; i<preparedSearch.spaceSearches.length; i++) { if(keysSpacesBestScores[i] === NEGATIVE_INFINITY) continue outer }
        } else {
        var hasAtLeast1Match = false
        for(let i=0; i < keysLen; i++) { if(tmpResults[i]._score !== NEGATIVE_INFINITY) { hasAtLeast1Match = true; break } }
        if(!hasAtLeast1Match) continue
        }

        var objResults = new KeysResult(keysLen)
        for(let i=0; i < keysLen; i++) { objResults[i] = tmpResults[i] }

        if(containsSpace) {
        var score = 0
        for(let i=0; i<preparedSearch.spaceSearches.length; i++) score += keysSpacesBestScores[i]
        } else {
        // todo could rewrite this scoring to be more similar to when there's spaces
        // if we match multiple keys give us bonus points
        var score = NEGATIVE_INFINITY
        for(let i=0; i<keysLen; i++) {
            var result = objResults[i]
            if(result._score > -1000) {
            if(score > NEGATIVE_INFINITY) {
                var tmp = (score + result._score) / 4/*bonus score for having multiple matches*/
                if(tmp > score) score = tmp
            }
            }
            if(result._score > score) score = result._score
        }
        }

        objResults.obj = obj
        objResults._score = score
        if(options?.scoreFn) {
        score = options.scoreFn(objResults)
        if(!score) continue
        score = denormalizeScore(score)
        objResults._score = score
        }

        if(score < threshold) continue
        push_result(objResults)
    }

    // no keys
    } else {
    for(var i = 0; i < targetsLen; ++i) { var target = targets[i]
        if(!target) continue
        if(!isPrepared(target)) target = getPrepared(target)

        if((searchBitflags & target._bitflags) !== searchBitflags) continue
        var result = algorithm(preparedSearch, target)
        if(result === NULL) continue
        if(result._score < threshold) continue

        push_result(result)
    }
    }

    if(resultsLen === 0) return noResults
    var results = new Array(resultsLen)
    for(var i = resultsLen - 1; i >= 0; --i) results[i] = q.poll()
    results.total = resultsLen + limitedCount
    return results
}


// this is written as 1 function instead of 2 for minification. perf seems fine ...
// except when minified. the perf is very slow
var highlight = (result, open='<b>', close='</b>') => {
    var callback = typeof open === 'function' ? open : undefined

    var target      = result.target
    var targetLen   = target.length
    var indexes     = result.indexes
    var highlighted = ''
    var matchI      = 0
    var indexesI    = 0
    var opened      = false
    var parts       = []

    for(var i = 0; i < targetLen; ++i) { var char = target[i]
    if(indexes[indexesI] === i) {
        ++indexesI
        if(!opened) { opened = true
        if(callback) {
            parts.push(highlighted); highlighted = ''
        } else {
            highlighted += open
        }
        }

        if(indexesI === indexes.length) {
        if(callback) {
            highlighted += char
            parts.push(callback(highlighted, matchI++)); highlighted = ''
            parts.push(target.substr(i+1))
        } else {
            highlighted += char + close + target.substr(i+1)
        }
        break
        }
    } else {
        if(opened) { opened = false
        if(callback) {
            parts.push(callback(highlighted, matchI++)); highlighted = ''
        } else {
            highlighted += close
        }
        }
    }
    highlighted += char
    }

    return callback ? parts : highlighted
}


var prepare = (target) => {
    if(typeof target === 'number') target = ''+target
    else if(typeof target !== 'string') target = ''
    var info = prepareLowerInfo(target)
    return new_result(target, {_targetLower:info._lower, _targetLowerCodes:info.lowerCodes, _bitflags:info.bitflags})
}

var cleanup = () => { preparedCache.clear(); preparedSearchCache.clear() }
